summary: Provides a guideline for creating country-specific civic address considerations documents, as required by RFC 4776. It also creates an IANA registry for such documents and registers the one for Austria. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Addresses are written differently in different countries. This document sets up a list where each country can explain its rules, and begins with Austria.

questions: how are civic addresses handled per country in pidf-lo
what is the civic address considerations registry
